camel_example: aliyun ice SubmitCopyrightJob --region cn-hangzhou --Input '{"Type":"OSS","Media":"oss://bucket/object"}' --Message Copyright_watermark_test --Output '{"Type":"OSS","Media":"oss://test-bucket/output.mp4"}' --version 2020-11-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Submits a video copyright watermark job
description_zh: 调用SubmitCopyrightJob提交视频版权水印任务
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-copyright-job --input Type=OSS Media=oss://bucket/object --biz-output Type=OSS Media=oss://test-bucket/output.mp4 --message Copyright_watermark_test --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitCopyrightJob

fields.help_en:
The information about the input file. Both OSS URLs and media asset IDs are supported.
The OSS URL rules are as follows:

oss://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object

In the URLs, bucket is the name of the OSS bucket that is in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
fields.help_zh:
输入文件信息，支持OSS地址和媒资ID两种。
OSS地址规则为：

1、oss://bucket/object

2、http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The type of the input file. Valid values:
OSS: the URL of the OSS file.
Media: the ID of the media asset
fields.help_zh:
输入文件类型，取值：
OSS：OSS文件地址
Media：媒资ID
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The video file to which the watermark is to be added.

The region of the OSS file or media asset must be the same as the region of the current IMS
parameters.help_zh:
待添加水印的视频文件。

OSS文件/媒资的地域需要与当前IMS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: input

fields.help_en:
The information about the output file. Only OSS URLs are supported. The OSS URL rules are as follows:

oss://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object
In the URLs, bucket is the name of the OSS bucket that is in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
fields.help_zh:
输出文件信息，支持 OSS 地址。 OSS 地址规则为：

1、oss://bucket/object

2、http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object
其中 bucket 为和当前项目处于同一区域的 oss bucket 名称，object 为文件路径
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The type of the output file. Valid values:

OSS: the URL of the OSS file
fields.help_zh:
输出文件类型，取值：

OSS：OSS文件地址
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the output file.

The region of OSS must be the same as the region of the current IMS
parameters.help_zh:
输出文件地址。

OSS的地域需要与当前IMS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: output

parameters.help_en: The watermark information to be added
parameters.name: message

parameters.help_en: The start time of the watermark, in seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 水印起始时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为0
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the watermark, in seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is the duration of the video
parameters.help_zh: 水印结束时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为视频时长
parameters.name: total_time

parameters.help_en: The watermark level, which indicates the embedding channel. Valid values: 0 (0u), 1 (1uv), and 2 (2yuv)
parameters.help_zh: 水印级别，取值0/1/2，表示嵌入通道，0u，1uv，2yuv
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: The description of the watermark information
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The user-defined data, with a maximum length of 1,024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
The parameters of the watermark job, in the JSON string format. The following parameters are supported:

algoType: the algorithm type. Default value: v1.
v1: long video copyright watermark, which supports only videos longer than 3 minutes.
v2: short video copyright watermark
parameters.help_zh:
水印任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

algoType：算法类型，默认值为v1。
v1：长视频版权水印，仅支持3min以上的。
v2：短视频版权水印
parameters.name: params
